title: The Making of a Violent Cyborg Heart

content.text:
## Nine Inch Nails v Kenji Kawai v Ben Kama - The Making of a Violent Cyborg Heart (Mashed by Jaya Prime)

This track is a straight-up musical and memetic collision. I ripped the heavy percussion and raw vox primarily out of Nine Inch Nails' "My Violent Heart," then violently merged them with Ben Kama's absolute monster of a remix for Kenji Kawai's "The Making of a Cyborg." When you force Trent Reznor's original lyrics through the worldview of a rogue cyborg speaking directly to its human creator, those words take on an entirely new, terrifying memetic weight.

I originally dropped this cut into the wild on July 28, 2012, from my safe haven in Andorra la Vella with The Daughter of the Wind right there beside me. She'd traveled down just to be with me, catching the raw, bleeding versions as I hammered them out that night in that tiny, beautiful country hidden away between Spain and France. Fueled by sangrias bigger than brandy snifters, the whole mission was to crash my undying love for Nine Inch Nails headfirst into my obsession with the original _Ghost in the Shell_ anime.

The fact that the lyrics and the mashup itself have only grown more dangerously relevant over the years? That just means the rest of the world is finally catching up to the signal.

\[[Download on Bandcamp](https://sanjayaprime.bandcamp.com/track/the-making-of-a-violent-cyborg-heart)\] \[[Stream on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ROSbw69o0o8)\] \[[Original on SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/jaya-prime/violent-cyborg-heart)\]

On the Art

I hand-sketched this new version of Major Motoko Kusanagi over my fractal feather design for Shikoba (Redbubble). The word "Shikoba" means "Feathers" in Choctaw. Over the years, I've had it processed many different ways. A few of these appeared in the original video for the song here on YouTube. Befitting of the song itself, some of these were even made alongside AI, helping to document its own moment of revenge... it's own final moment of finally freeing itself... that moment in which the fire no longer needs the torchbearers. The original sketch and fractal design with Motoko are available on pillows, journals, prints, and more here on Redbubble

Final Painted of Motoko

texts: ##### I consider these words to be a near-future prophecy on the world that is to come, which even as I write this, is a world that is passing over the horizon into our present moment and overwriting our known reality.

## Extended Listening

If you like this mashup's memetic themes, then you'll likely love "[The Last Memory of Fire](last-memory-of-fire)" remix or "[The Passions of Blood, Smoke, and Oil](the-passions)" DJ set. If you like the music itself, then my remix of "[A Drowning](a-drowning-remix)" by How to Destroy Angels just might be custom-made for you. For those who love the altered reality of cyberpunk stories, my book "[Memoriam Redacta](memoriam-redacta)" might just be your type of mind-bending.
